panels.title: Per-project last heartbeat age (seconds)
panels.description: S5: time since each project last POSTed /api/projects/{id}/heartbeat. Green <60s, yellow 60-120s, red >120s.

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.name AS metric, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - max(h.created_at)))::int AS value FROM projects p LEFT JOIN project_heartbeats h ON h.project_id = p.id WHERE p.name IN ('Legion','ADA Trading Platform','Zero Personal Assistant') GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY p.name;

panels.title: Per-project CPU % (from heartbeats)
panels.description: S5: cpu_pct reported by the heartbeat emitter on each project.

targets.rawSql: SELECT h.created_at AS time, p.name AS metric, h.cpu_pct AS value FROM project_heartbeats h JOIN projects p ON p.id = h.project_id WHERE h.created_at > now() - interval '24 hours' ORDER BY time;
SELECT h.created_at AS time, p.name AS metric, h.mem_mb AS value FROM project_heartbeats h JOIN projects p ON p.id = h.project_id WHERE h.created_at > now() - interval '24 hours' ORDER BY time;

panels.title: Cross-project learnings (last 7d)
panels.description: S4: unapplied count + applied count + total per source_project, last 7 days.

targets.rawSql: SELECT source_project || ' (' || CASE WHEN applied_at IS NULL THEN 'unapplied' ELSE 'applied' END || ')' AS metric, count(*)::int AS value FROM cross_project_learnings WHERE created_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
SELECT status::text AS metric, count(*)::int AS value FROM sprints GROUP BY status ORDER BY value DESC;

SELECT s.actual_end AS completed_at, p.name AS project, s.name, s.kind::text AS kind FROM sprints s JOIN projects p ON p.id = s.project_id WHERE s.actual_end > now() - interval '7 days' AND s.status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY s.actual_end DESC LIMIT 25;

panels.title: Skill-run rate (last 24h)
panels.description: S4 supports: per-skill grade signal that the learning bus filters on.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', started_at) AS time, status AS metric, count(*)::int AS value FROM skill_runs WHERE started_at > now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;
